title: Elijah and the Prophets of Baal on Carmel
description: Elijah challenges 450 prophets of Baal on Mount Carmel to a test to determine who is the true God. Fire from the Lord falls from heaven and consumes the sacrifice, the people confess that the Lord is God, and God sends rain over the land after a long drought.

versions.reason: [minor] references: The existing story 'Elijah Prays for Rain on Carmel' covers verses 41-46. This new story covers the entire chapter 1-46, which includes the rain scene. This is a broader story that naturally encompasses the narrower one. Should be merged into one unified account of the Carmel event.
